SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) AS row_count, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members, min(valid_from) AS min_from, max(valid_from) AS max_from, min(valid_to) AS min_to, max(valid_to) AS max_to
FROM dim_member
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT count(*) AS total_rows, count(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_ids,
 sum(CASE WHEN is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS flagged_current,
 sum(CASE WHEN valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_ended,
 sum(CASE WHEN is_current AND valid_to <> DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cur_but_closed,
 sum(CASE WHEN NOT is_current AND valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS notcur_but_open,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN is_current THEN member_id END) AS distinct_current_ids
FROM dim_member

calls.statement:
SELECT s.tier AS stg_tier, s.is_current AS stg_current, count(*) AS stg_rows, count(DISTINCT s.member_id) AS stg_ids,
 min(s.valid_from) AS min_from, max(s.valid_from) AS max_from,
 sum(CASE WHEN d.member_key IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS key_in_dim,
 sum(CASE WHEN d.member_key IS NOT NULL AND d.tier = s.tier AND d.valid_from = s.valid_from AND d.is_current = s.is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS identical_in_dim,
 sum(CASE WHEN d.member_key IS NULL AND s.is_current THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS new_current_not_in_dim
FROM stg_member_updates s LEFT JOIN dim_member d ON d.member_key = s.member_key
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT
 count(*) AS gold_current,
 sum(CASE WHEN join_date > DATE '2026-10-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN valid_from > DATE '2026-10-08' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_valid_from,
 sum(CASE WHEN join_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS null_join,
 sum(CASE WHEN home_store_id NOT IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orphan_home_store,
 min(member_id) AS min_id, max(member_id) AS max_id,
 count(DISTINCT member_key) AS distinct_keys,
 sum(CASE WHEN member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-04') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overlapping_hist
FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier = 'Gold'

SELECT 'overlap_versions' AS check_name, count(*) AS n FROM dim_member a JOIN dim_member b ON a.member_id=b.member_id AND a.member_key<b.member_key AND a.valid_from<=b.valid_to AND b.valid_from<=a.valid_to
UNION ALL SELECT 'ids_not_12345_digits', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND length(CAST(member_id AS VARCHAR)) <> (SELECT max(length(CAST(member_id AS VARCHAR))) FROM dim_member)
UNION ALL SELECT 'consent_null_gold', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND marketing_consent IS NULL
UNION ALL SELECT 'gold_with_marketing_consent', count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND marketing_consent
